{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline == -999 (QC failure)
df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq per patient
df = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check the range of biomarker_final values by assay_batch
batch_a_values = df[df['assay_batch'] == 'A']['biomarker_final']
batch_b_values = df[df['assay_batch'] == 'B']['biomarker_final']

print(f'Batch A (ng/mL): min={batch_a_values.min():.1f}, max={batch_a_values.max():.1f}')
print(f'Batch B (µg/L): min={batch_b_values.min():.1f}, max={batch_b_values.max():.1f}')

# Check if batch B values are roughly 10× larger than batch A values
# If so, this supports the unit conversion
ratio_min = batch_b_values.min() / batch_a_values.max() if not batch_a_values.empty else None
ratio_max = batch_b_values.max() / batch_a_values.min() if not batch_a_values.empty else None

print(f'Ratio (min batch B / max batch A): {ratio_min:.2f} if valid')
print(f'Ratio (max batch B / min batch A): {ratio_max:.2f} if valid')"}
